stem_book: Fill in the blanks with appropriate terms. (i) The sum of integers from 1 to 100 that are divisible by 2 or 5 is ____. (ii) If a, b, c are in G.P., then the equations ax² + 2bx + c = 0 and dx² + 2ex + f = 0 have a common root if d/a, e/b, f/c are in ____. (iii) Sum of the first n terms of the series 1/2 + 3/4 + 7/8 + 15/16 + ...... is equal to ____. (iv) An infinite G.P. has first term 'x' and sum '5', then x belongs to ____.
reason: Quick-recap fill-in-the-blank with four sub-parts, each with its own answer; manifest split it into 4 entries sharing one code. Printed key (iv) −10 < x < 0 is wrong: x = 5(1 − r), −1 < r < 1, r ≠ 0 gives 0 < x < 10.
